beats.spoken: tum jo prompts app banane ke liye de rahe ho na, usse ghanta kuch nahi hone wala
beats.visual: P-STACK-TEXT: the vague prompt card ('make my app better') struck out in red on 'ghanta' while the line stack builds sans / italic serif on warm paper
